chunks: From him, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ghalib ibn Usman, from Bashir al-Dahhan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'O son of Adam! Mention Me in a gathering, I shall mention you in a gathering better than your gathering.'

key_terms.مَلَإٍ: A gathering or assembly of people

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for remembering Allah in a gathering according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith qudsi underscores the communal dimension of dhikr, highlighting that public remembrance of Allah invites a reciprocal divine acknowledgment in a superior assembly, often interpreted as the gathering of the angels or the faithful in the Hereafter. Shia scholars emphasize this reciprocity as a spiritual incentive for maintaining presence of heart in congregational prayers and gatherings, linking individual devotion to collective spiritual elevation.
